Mike H: Heads-up — we need to cut over the dashboard storage shape for route-level metrics this week. Proposal: dual-write to analytics.compact_route_metrics (new) + existing events store, then switch console read path to readshim. Who can own the migration window?
Anya P: I can own coordination. Question: do we plan to change the quota schema (quota_window -> quota_windows array) as part of this cutover or follow a separate patch?
Sanjay R: prefer separate change. If we change both at once it makes backfills risky. Keep shape change minimal (compactification) and follow with field evolution later.
Kelly L: How long for the dual-write warmup? need to ensure dashboards/alerts see parity before flag flip. Can we do a 5% traffic split for 48h? :eyes:
Mike H: 5%/48h SGTM. We'll need canary queries and a read-compare job. Sanjay — can you sketch the probe queries we should run?
Sanjay R: Sure. Probe set:
```
-- sample probe to compare counts and p99
SELECT route_id, count(*) as cnt_old, new.cnt as cnt_new, approx_percentile(latency_ms, 0.99) as p99_old, new.p99 as p99_new
FROM analytics.route_metrics_old old
JOIN (
  SELECT route_id, count(*) as cnt, approx_percentile(latency_ms, 0.99) as p99
  FROM analytics.compact_route_metrics
  WHERE ts >= now() - interval '1 hour'
  GROUP BY route_id
) new ON old.route_id = new.route_id
WHERE abs(cnt_old - new.cnt) / nullif(cnt_old,0) > 0.01
LIMIT 200;
```
Sanjay R: Also run payload-level diffs for a small set of routes (10 high-card routes) hourly.
Anya P: Backfill plan: shadow backfill first (write-only to new table), validate with probes, then one-time migration window for historical partitions. Backfill job will use chunked updates with idempotency and a tombstone marker.
Kelly L: Alerting: update console alerting rules to read from readshim alias. Add a temporary rule to fire if readshim p99 > old p99 by 20% for >10m. Also update dashboard links to surface "data freshness" from the backfill job.
ingest-bot: migration-job-scheduler: Backfill job scheduled: analytics.backfill.compact_route_metrics (chunk_size=10k, concurrency=8). ETA start: 2026-03-25T02:00Z.
Mike H: Nice. One more: query contract — we need a small compatibility adapter for quota queries because frontend expects quota_window string. Can we add a lightweight SQL function to materialize quota_window from quota_windows[0] for the shim?
Sanjay R: Yep — implement shim function quota_window_v1(meta jsonb) RETURNS text AS $$ SELECT (meta->'quota_windows'->0->>'unit') $$; Add as read-only view in `console_v1` schema. That keeps console code untouched during rollout.
Anya P: I'll add a migration checklist: dualwrite flag, backfill scheduled, probe queries running, canary traffic config, readshim view deployed, dashboard alerts updated, rollback steps documented.
Kelly L: Rollback plan: flip dualwrite off, switch read path back to old table, cancel backfill (tombstone left), alert ops. Ensure backfill has resume tokens so we can pick up later.
Mike H: Perfect. I'll create the feature flag and add the 5% traffic rule. Ping me when the readshim view is ready so I can schedule the canary. :thumbsup:
